stages.description: 畫準備、儲存、操作與讀出流程，為每類失敗指定分母與互相重疊的可能性。 依案例來源只註記可查證的裝置／方法；另以虛線標出本課新增的簡化假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Map preparation, storage, operation and readout, assigning denominators and possible overlaps. Use the source only to label documented devices or methods; mark this exercise's simplifying assumptions with dashed connections.
